Test 1.45 touch screen display

Name: Design & Finalize Wheelchair Mounting
Description: Confirm ball joint + tube clamp non-invasive mounting, test vibration resistance, document final configuration
Checklist Items:

Confirm ball joint 1/4 inch thread fits Watcher mount point

Connect USB-C cable from 10000mAh LiPo battery pack
Secure cable along armrest with velcro cable ties
Confirm install time under 5 minutes
Confirm removal time under 2 minutes

Name: Configure SenseCraft Detection for Wheelchair Obstacles
Description: Configure SenseCraft model settings to reliably detect furniture, walls, and people as CAREC obstacles
Checklist Items:

Enable object detection mode
Test detection: chair, wall, person, door frame, box
Verify detection labels appear on 1.45 inch display and in app
Tune confidence threshold (target >0.7)
Test at all three CAREC zones: 30cm (RED) / 80cm (YELLOW) / 120cm (GREEN)
Confirm SenseCraft JSON detection output parseable by CAREC firmware
Document model name and version in SENSECAP_WATCHER_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md

Name: CAREC: Phase 1 Safety Logic - Weeks 3-4
Description: Implement distance thresholds using SenseCraft detections, 3-tier beep patterns, display alerts, BLE to caregiver app
Checklist Items:
Implement distance_estimator.h (bounding-box area heuristic)
Implement thresholds: DIST_RED=60cm / DIST_YELLOW=100cm in CAREC_obstacle_detection.ino
Implement directional_beep_patterns.h (3 patterns via 1W speaker)
Implement display_alert() for 1.45 inch touch screen (color-coded)
Wire beep_trigger() and beep_update() in main 100ms loop
BLE alert JSON to SenseCraft Mate on danger events
Run tests/obstacle_test.py — all assertions pass
Field test with obstacles at 30cm (RED), 80cm (YELLOW), 120cm (GREEN)

Name: Implement Distance Thresholds
Description: Define DIST_RED=60cm / DIST_YELLOW=100cm zone boundaries using SenseCraft bounding-box size as distance proxy in distance_estimator.h
Checklist Items:
Define DIST_RED = 60 in CAREC_obstacle_detection.ino
Define DIST_YELLOW = 100
Verify 3-tier zones: RED (<60cm), YELLOW (60-100cm), GREEN (100+cm)
Implement nearest_obstacle_cm() in distance_estimator.h
Use bounding box area as distance proxy (larger box = closer object)
Calibrate scaling constant against measured distances
Test threshold logic at actual measured distances (ruler)
Log distance + alert type to Serial at 115200 baud

Name: Implement Directional Beep Patterns
Description: Map danger level to beep pattern via built-in 1W speaker: caution 1/sec, warning 2/sec, critical rapid continuous
Checklist Items:
Implement BEEP_CAUTION: 1 beep/sec in directional_beep_patterns.h
Implement BEEP_WARNING: 2 beeps/sec
Implement BEEP_CRITICAL: rapid continuous
Implement BEEP_NONE: silent
Wire beep_trigger() and non-blocking beep_update() in main loop
Test volume: 1W speaker audible at 2m with wheelchair motor running
Verify OTA blocked during CRITICAL/WARNING (safety-critical)
Verify OTA unblocked during CAUTION/NONE

Name: Implement Touch Screen Visual Alerts (1.45 inch Display)
Description: Use Watcher built-in 1.45 inch 412x412 display for color-coded visual feedback alongside audio beeps
Checklist Items:
Review SenseCraft display API in Seeed GitHub repo
Implement display_alert(level) function
GREEN (100+cm): green solid-on indicator
YELLOW (60-100cm): yellow slow-blink warning
RED (<60cm): red fast-blink critical alert
Test display visibility in bright room and dim room
Test display + speaker simultaneously (both active)

Name: Failure Mode Analysis

Checklist Items:
Simulate SenseCraft detection model error → verify safe fallback (beep last known pattern)
Cover OV5647 camera lens → log error, continue operating
Disconnect WiFi → confirm OTA pauses, detection continues unaffected
Disconnect BLE → confirm standalone detection still works
Drain battery to 5% → confirm low-battery alert to caregiver app
Simulate WiFi reconnect → confirm OTA resumes
Document system behavior for each failure mode
Verify no scenario causes crash or silent failure

Name: Safety Protocol Validation
Description: Test all CAREC safety scenarios: slow approach, fast approach, multiple obstacles, low light, false positive measurement
Checklist Items:
Test slow-approach obstacle (2 cm/sec) → must detect before 60cm (DIST_RED boundary)
Test fast approach (<500ms encounter) → must detect before 60cm (DIST_RED boundary)
Test multiple simultaneous obstacles → nearest one takes priority
Test detection in low light (night-light only room, target >70% accuracy)
Measure false positive rate: 30-min empty-room session (target <5%)
Measure false negative rate: 50 obstacle approaches (target <2%)
Document all test results
Get caregiver and therapist sign-off

Document rollback procedure in firmware/SETUP.md
